input: Arrange airport transfers for my parents' visit

gold.taskTitle: Arrange Airport Transfers for Parents' Visit
gold.taskDescription: Organise reliable airport pickup and drop-off transfers for the user's parents during their upcoming visit.

questions.title: Which airport are your parents arriving at and departing from?
questions.description: Identify the specific airport(s) involved so the correct transfer routes can be planned.

questions.title: What are their exact arrival and departure dates and times?
questions.description: Capture the precise flight schedule to ensure transfers are booked for the right windows.

questions.title: How many people and how much luggage will there be?
questions.description: Determine the passenger count and luggage volume to select an appropriately sized vehicle.

questions.title: What is the pickup and drop-off destination address?
questions.description: Get the exact address where parents need to be taken to and collected from.

questions.title: Do your parents have any mobility or accessibility requirements?
questions.description: Check for wheelchair access, assistance needs, or other physical considerations that affect vehicle or service choice.

questions.title: What is your budget range for the transfers?
questions.description: Understand the spending limit to filter suitable transfer options, from budget taxis to private car services.

questions.title: Do you prefer a pre-booked private service or a taxi on the day?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred transfer type to narrow down the booking approach and providers to contact.
